evidence.quote: Nonetheless, the level of credit outstanding for households has been very slow to rebound and remains lower than it was at the onset of the crisis.
With nearly 10 percent of the workforce unemployed and many more underemployed, a significant number of households experienced sharply reduced incomes.

I plan to set the stage for this conference by focusing on three topics that are of particular interest to the Federal Reserve: changes in consumer credit, changes in the use of payment methods, and regulatory developments that affect both consumer credit and payments.

parsed.rationale: The speech is about consumer credit, payment methods and regulation, and it takes no monetary policy view. Its description of weak household credit and high unemployment leans mildly dovish on activity, but the overall stance is neutral.
